note: Illinois DNR park near Oglesby and Utica, known for its sandstone canyons above the Illinois River. The campground is on the upland south of the canyons, with two wooded loops off one road: West (1-58) and East (59-133). Gravel back-in pads; the seasonal camp store is run by the lodge. --Claude
